# Aurora Filtech Co., Ltd (https://www.aurora-filtech.com)

> Industrial Filter Fabrics, Paper Machine Clothing (PMC), Spiral Fabrics & Mesh Belts Manufacturer. 30+ years experience, 3 factories in China & UK office, in-house monofilament extrusion, German Dornier weaving looms (widths up to 6,000 mm), heat setting, laser cutting & automated seaming. OEM/ODM worldwide.

## Full Machine-Readable Catalog
- [Complete Engineering Catalog & Spec Tables](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/llms-full.txt): All models, CFM air permeability ratings, yarn diameters, OEM machine compatibility, and glossary.

## Core Product Lines
- [Forming Fabric](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/forming-fabric/): Forming fabrics (also known as forming wire) for paper machines and nonwoven forming machines. 1-layer, 1.5-layer, 2-layer and 3-layer constructions with anti-hydrolysis monofilament.
- [Dryer Fabric](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/dryer-fabric/): Anti-static dryer fabrics and dryer belts for board forming, paper drying and food drying machines. Anti-static, anti-hydrolysis and heat-resistant constructions with strong warp loop seams.
- [Spiral Fabric (Spiral Belt)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/spiral-belt/): Spiral fabrics and spiral belts for belt press filter dewatering and dryer applications. PET and PPS monofilament spirals joined by hinge pins — with or without filler yarns — custom widths and edge treatments.
- [Vacuum Filter Fabric (Vacuum Filter Belt)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/vacuum-fabric/): Vacuum filter fabrics for vacuum belt filters and vacuum disc filters in power plant FGD, phosphoric acid and mining filtration. Seamless or seamed, custom sizes.
- [Press Filter Fabric (Filter Cloth)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/press-fabric/): Press filter fabrics and filter cloths for frame press filters, membrane press filters, drum, disc and leaf filters — oil, mining, lithium phosphate filtration and sludge dewatering.
- [Press Filter Belt (Dewatering Belt)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/press-belt/): Press filter belts (dewatering belts) for belt press filters in sludge dewatering, sand washing, juice squeezing and palm oil squeezing. Reinforced seams, custom lengths.
- [Filter Bag (Dust Collector Bag)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/filter-bag/): Dust filter bags for bag filters and dust collectors in power plants and cement plants. PET, PPS, Nomex, P84 and PTFE felt options with membrane and anti-static finishes.
- [Filter Cartridge (Cartridge Filter)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/filter-cartridge/): Industrial filter cartridges for air, water and oil filtration systems. Anti-static, PTFE, PPS, cellulose and Nomex series with matched end caps and gaskets.
- [Polyester Square Mesh (Plain Weave)](https://www.aurora-filtech.com/products/square-mesh/): Polyester monofilament square mesh (plain weave, square weave) from 40 to 200 mesh count — fine mesh conveyor belts for wood panel and biomass drying, and screening/sifting mesh for wood flour and WPC.
